 It can be combined with cement inside to give strength and sturdiness to the product. This collection is for both indoor and outdoor use.

A collection that celebrates the inherent charm of Asian seagrass. These planters expertly combine genuine polypropylen and seagrass yielding robust and visually appealing pieces. The distinctive natural hue and chara­cteristi c woven look of the seagrass bring a sense of tranquil elegance and natural warmth to any setting. Seagrass concept is designed to enhance your garden and home with effortless natural beauty.

Experience the authentic essence of Asian nature. This exquisite collection of planters beautifully marries the traditional allure of skin bamboo with the durability of poly­propylen and cement. Each piece celebrates the natural color and unique, inherent character of the bamboo skin, inviting a profound sense of relaxation and a deeper connection to the natural world. Perfectly suited for indoor. Bamboo concept brings the tranquil beauty of Asia directly to your home and garden .

Ro-cement is a unique garden planter collection using concrete and specialized handling technique. 
Due to the strong construction of natural stone and minerals, it is a perfect collection with variety of paint and pigment colors. 
It is lightweight and weather resistant, and environment friendly. This collection is for both indoor and outdoor use.

Oyster-concrete is an antique-style collection that is made of cement, fiberglass and sand. Although the planters have the thin thickness,
they make you to be surprised with strength and durability of materials. With the natural surface, antique colors and classic finishes, the collection
brings you to have a feeling close to the ocean. This collection is recommended for both indoor and outdoor use.

A light concrete planter with a chalk stone finish for a soft, matte texture that exudes natural elegance. The refined surface adds a subtle, organic feel while maintaining durability for both indoor and outdoor spaces. Modern aesthetic with a handcrafted touch!

A light cement planter with a sand rock finish, offering a raw, textured surface that mimics natural stone formations. The unique treatment enhances its organic appeal while ensuring durability, making it a stylish yet sturdy choice for both indoor and outdoor spaces.

A cement planter crafted using a unique rotating technique, creating a distinctive and refined finish. The dynamic motion during production results in subtle texture variations and a smooth, artistic surface that sets it apart. Durable, stylish, and truly one-of-a-kind!

A combination of cement fiber board and reinforced fiberglass creates a great collection for a natural look 
in your garden. Our cement fiber collection relies on environmentally sustainable principles and is guaranteed without asbestos. All products 
of the collection have an ultra-flat surface and light weight. All cement fiber planters are always offered with insert pots. 
This collection is for both indoor and outdoor use.

A poly-fiberglass planter crafted using a unique rotating technique, creating a distinctive and refined finish. The dynamic motion during production results in subtle texture variations and a smooth, modern artistic surface that sets it apart.

The compound of poly resin, fiber glass & stone powder give the birth of the light weight products among the stoneware. The products keep all advantages of the stone aspects without heaviness. This collection is for both indoor and outdoor use.

Our Sand Fiber collection brings the beauty of nature into your garden and house. It is a compound of poly resin, fiberglass, and stone powder to create a lightweight and durable product. The products are delicately treated to create the surface with natural scratches as well as simple colors yet reconcilable with nature. This collection is for both indoor and outdoor use.
